name: T. Rowe Price

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (T. Rowe Price wordmark.svg)

description: T. Rowe Price is an active investment manager: it runs mutual funds, retirement target-date funds, separate accounts and subadvised portfolios for individuals, retirement plans and institutions, and is paid an annual percentage fee on the assets it manages. Revenue therefore rises and falls with stock and bond markets and with client inflows and outflows, not with trading activity; the average fee rate has been falling (39.4 basis points in 2025 vs 41.9 in 2023) as money shifts toward cheaper products and passive funds. Equity funds earn about 59 percent of advisory fees. It also earns administrative, distribution and servicing fees and a small amount of carried-interest income.

employees.note: 7,773 associates, down 4.7 percent from 8,158 a year earlier.

businessLines.name: Equity
businessLines.how: Annual fee as a percentage of average equity assets managed (mutual funds, trusts, separate accounts); revenue moves with stock prices and with flows.

businessLines.name: Multi-asset (target date and blended funds)
businessLines.how: Annual percentage fee on average assets in target-date retirement funds and balanced portfolios, mainly sold through retirement plans where money flows in steadily from contributions.

businessLines.name: Fixed income, including money market
businessLines.how: Annual percentage fee on average bond and money market assets; lower fee rate than equity.

businessLines.name: Alternatives
businessLines.how: Fees on private credit, real assets and other alternative funds, plus carried interest (accrued carried interest +$149.5M in 2025, before $68.3M acquisition-related amortisation and impairments, net $81.2M).

businessLines.name: Administrative, distribution, servicing and other fees
businessLines.how: Fees for transfer-agent, fund accounting and administrative services (506.3) and distribution and servicing (87.6) charged to the funds, not tied to a single asset class.

businessLines.name: Performance-based advisory fees and capital allocation-based income
businessLines.how: Performance fees earned only when a portfolio beats its benchmark (37.4) plus carried interest in private funds net of amortisation (81.2); lumpy and market-dependent.

brands.name: T. Rowe Price Associates (TRPA)
brands.note: Main US investment adviser subsidiary; also T. Rowe Price Investment Management (TRPIM) and T. Rowe Price International Ltd (TRPIL)

brands.name: Oak Hill Advisors (OHA)
brands.note: Alternatives (credit, private markets) manager that is part of T. Rowe Price (named in the 10-K as one of the main advisers with TRPA, TRPIM and TRPIL, with its own independent risk committee); its separate AUM and revenue are not disclosed in the 10-K text reviewed
